headline.text: L1 dish wash areas show *nut-allergen cross-contact* — nut items found in wheat-designated zone, all areas uncleaned since Friday.

summary: Three allergen/sanitation gaps at L1: nut items in wheat dish-wash area, weekend cleaning skipped, and HER Almonds carton with bad print left from prior week. L3 reports lost tools on MF Matrix line; location unknown.

food_safety.title: Lost work tools at MF Matrix line
food_safety.summary: Tools reported lost on MF Matrix line with no indication of recovery or location confirmed.
food_safety.status: Open, location and recovery status unknown at window close.

quality.title: HER Almonds carton with bad print found from prior week
quality.summary: Full box of HER Almonds with bad print discovered on Sollich 2, leftover from last week's run — line clearance incomplete.
quality.status: Resolved — carton identified and flagged, escalated to shift leads for clearance follow-up.

sanitation.title: Air treatment unit water pooling, Matrix 678
sanitation.summary: Active water flow from air treatment unit Matrix 678 with no drainage path; area cleanup scheduled.
sanitation.status: Open — sanitation team scheduled to clean area Monday morning.

sanitation.title: Gondola cleaning pending for CNC changeover
sanitation.summary: Gondola cleaning required today for tomorrow's CNC run; plastic dust accumulation underneath needs solution before allergen changeover.
sanitation.status: Open — maintenance and quality escalated to resolve dust issue and complete cleaning today.

allergen.title: Dish wash allergen cross-contact — nut items in wheat zone
allergen.summary: Nut-allergen items found in wheat-designated dish wash area; no non-allergen zone available for S4 cleaning, and all three dish wash areas left uncleaned over weekend.
allergen.status: Open — escalated to sanitation leads and plant management for immediate corrective action.

Review dish wash area labeling and weekend sanitation accountability — based on nut-allergen cross-contact in wheat zone and missed weekend cleaning.
